preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Attacker must have some token balance to be blacklisted

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first add the attacker's address to the blacklist using addBlackList(). Then call destroyBlackFunds() on the attacker's address to seize their tokens and increase the owner's balance. The owner can also use issue() to mint unlimited tokens or redeem() to burn tokens arbitrarily.
